story: A great god, Phra Narai, incarnates in various forms. As a boar he defeats a demon. Later, the god Phra Isuan grants his servant Nonthok a diamond finger that kills anyone he points at; when tricked by Phra Narai disguised as a dancing woman, Nonthok points at himself and dies, later reborn as the ten-faced demon king Thotsakan of Lanka. Thotsakan marries Kala Akhi and receives Nang Montho from Phra Isuan, fathering Intharachit. Meanwhile monkey princes Phali and Sukhrip are born from a queen's adultery with gods, becoming monkeys after a river test. Phali gains a magic trident and steals Sukhrip's bride and later Thotsakan's wife, fathering Ongkhot, then banishes Sukhrip, who meets Hanuman, born from divine weapons placed in a maiden's mouth. Phra Ram, an incarnation of Phra Narai, falls in love with Nang Sida (Laksami reborn, secretly Thotsakan's daughter) at an archery contest. Exiled to the forest with his brother Phra Lak, Phra Ram spurns the demoness Sammanakha, prompting Thotsakan to abduct Nang Sida. Phra Ram allies with Hanuman, Sukhrip, and Chomphuphan; Hanuman finds Sida, burns Lanka, and helps build a causeway. Phra Ram kills Thotsakan and Intharachit, frees Sida, who passes a fire ordeal, and they return home. Later, doubting her fidelity, Phra Ram orders her killed, but Phra Lak spares her; she bears twin sons in exile with a hermit. Phra Ram seeks her return; she vanishes into the underworld, until Phra Isuan finally reunites them.
blind: A great sky god incarnates in various forms. As an animal he defeats a demon. Later, another high god grants his servant a magical finger that kills anyone he points at; when tricked by the sky god disguised as a dancing woman, the servant points at himself and dies, later reborn as a multi-headed demon king of an island kingdom. The demon king marries a woman and receives another wife as a gift from the high god, fathering a son. Meanwhile two monkey princes are born from a queen's adultery with gods, becoming monkeys after a river test. The elder gains a magic weapon and steals his brother's bride and later the demon king's wife, fathering a son, then banishes his brother, who meets a monkey general born from divine weapons placed in a maiden's mouth. A hero, an incarnation of the sky god, falls in love with a princess (secretly the demon king's daughter, and an incarnation of a goddess) at an archery contest. Exiled to the forest with his brother, the hero spurns a demoness, prompting the demon king to abduct the princess. The hero allies with the monkey general, the exiled brother-prince, and a bear-prince; the monkey general finds the princess, burns the island kingdom, and helps build a causeway. The hero kills the demon king and his son, frees the princess, who passes a fire ordeal, and they return home. Later, doubting her fidelity, the hero orders her killed, but his brother spares her; she bears twin sons in exile with a hermit. The hero seeks her return; she vanishes into the underworld, until the high god finally reunites them.
title: Ramakien
